How do you price your fees?
Every engagement is scoped in a conversation first, and the fee is set out in a written proposal before any work begins.
May we use your DACE/ DDDLP accreditations and prepare the work ourselves?
Our credentials cannot be applied to work prepared elsewhere. Attaching our DACE and DDDLP accreditations to external materials misleads SWDA assessors and fails quality checks on audit.
What is your turnaround time for delivery?
Because we operate as a dedicated team rather than solo practitioners, our turnaround is significantly faster than independent courseware developers.

The initial consultation is a brief exchange to understand your objectives and assess your eligibility for SWDA funding across different tracks. We give straightforward guidance on feasibility and timelines.
